title: Creamy Ravioli al Pomodoro
description: Cheese ravioli tossed in a rich tomato-basil sauce made silky with ricotta, cream, Parmesan, and garlic, finished with cherry tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook the ravioli according to the package directions until just al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to caramelize it slightly.
Add the crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, black pepper, chili flakes (if using), and sugar. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Lower the heat and whisk in the ricotta cheese until completely smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and milk, then add the Parmesan cheese. Simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until the sauce becomes creamy and velvety.
Fold in the cherry tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes so they soften slightly while remaining fresh.
Add the cooked ravioli and gently toss to coat. Add reserved pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Turn off the heat and gently fold in half of the mozzarella pearls.
Serve immediately, topping with the remaining mozzarella pearls, fresh basil, extra Parmesan, cracked black pepper, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Ricotta gives the sauce a creamy texture without making it as heavy as an Alfredo sauce.
Use whole-milk ricotta for the smoothest consistency.
Fresh San Marzano tomatoes or high-quality canned tomatoes produce the best pomodoro flavor.
A spoonful of basil pesto stirred in just before serving adds another layer of flavor.
Pair with garlic bread or a simple arugula salad.
